summary: Tested new features 'Registro modifiche' (audit trail) and 'Gestione utenti/ruoli'. Backend: 41/41 pytest passed (27 previous + 14 new in test_audit_and_users.py covering RBAC 401/403 on /api/admin/audit, /api/admin/users, /api/admin/users/{id}/role; create/update/delete audit logging with correct fields incl. details listing changed fields on update; self-role 400, invalid-role 400, missing-user 404, promote->target can access admin endpoints, demote->403 restored). Frontend: admin login, subtab-catalogo CRUD on zTEST allergen, subtab-registro shows 15 audit entries (create/update/delete captured with actor and timestamp), subtab-utenti lists 25 users with role badges, own row shows 'tu' with no buttons, promote/demote flow updates badge Operatore<->Admin. Regression: non-admin operator has no tab-config visible; Nuovo Report/Storico tabs still functional.
critical_code_review_comments: AuditLog/AdminUsers Badge count text-testid resolves before async fetch completes on subtab click (renders as 0 momentarily). Not a bug, but tests must wait for the row/entry testid rather than reading the count immediately. Optional UX: show a small loading spinner while entries.length === 0 and fetch is inflight, to distinguish 'no data' from 'loading'.
log_allergen_change stores changed_by_email/name/timestamp/details correctly; consider indexing db.allergen_audit.timestamp desc for scale (currently .to_list(300) fine).
admin_list_users properly strips _id and password_hash; sort by created_at ascending is intentional (admin appears first).
test_credentials: duilbrugn@gmail.com / AllergoLab2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md); operator users created ad-hoc and demoted at end.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. zTEST_ allergens created and deleted in same test. Operator users test_ops_*, uiops_* created via /api/auth/register; promoted user was demoted back to 'user' before test end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New testids to leverage: subtab-catalogo, subtab-utenti, subtab-registro; audit-count, audit-refresh, audit-entry; admin-users-count, admin-users-refresh, admin-user-row-<email>, admin-user-role-<email>, admin-promote-<email>, admin-demote-<email>. When asserting UI counts, wait for at least one row/entry testid before reading the badge (Badge renders '0' during initial mount, updates after fetch).
